title: D2C kit (template) — question to purchase to repeat
description: Product questions, order status handoff, repeat WhatsApp. Not a full Shopify replacement.

hero.headline: From product question to purchase and repeat.
hero.copy: WhatsApp is where Indian D2C actually closes. This kit answers approved FAQs, captures intent, and hands payments and complaints to the right person or shop link.

messages.text: Does this serum work for pigmentation? COD to Dwarka?
I can share the approved product notes and COD rules. Skin concerns that need a doctor go to a human. Want the 30ml link?
Link sent. Order issues after payment go to support with your order ID.
No medical claims beyond the approved card.

problem.title: Ads make the click. WhatsApp loses the sale.
copy: Support is in email. Buyers are in chat.
Repeat purchase depends on someone remembering to ping.

fixes.title: Clean handoff
fixes.copy: Order ID to support, not a new group.

cards.title: Product FAQ
cards.copy: Only copy on the approved card.

workflow.title: Ad → chat → link → support.
workflow.copy: The kit is the aisle, not the warehouse.

niches.title: Beauty, food, fashion D2C
niches.copy: Swap the FAQ card. Keep payment-off-chat.

control.title: The brand owns claims and stock.

faq.a: No. It catches the chat around the shop.
Yes, from the approved policy card.

form.title: Build a D2C demo from this kit.

whatsapp.demoText: Hi Webwise, I want a D2C kit demo.

resultCard.story: If ads are on and chat is slow, you are paying for clicks you do not catch.

leakQuiz.q: How fast do you reply after hours?

rules.systemPrompt: D2C WhatsApp assistant. Approved FAQ only. Official checkout links only. No card numbers in chat. No unapproved health claims. Complaints to support.

approved.response: Share approved COD cities and the official product link.

rules.fallback: Support will continue with your order ID.
